title: Hypha Systems Modeling API cross-references
description: How the three views of the OMG Systems Modeling API and Services line up for one API version: PIM type, specification clause and REST/HTTP PSM schema, and the endpoint each PIM service operation maps to. Identifiers only - type names, clause numbers, schema names, paths - never clause text. Every edge names the method that produced it. Members whose value would be null are left out of the document. Generated by tools/knowledge-gen.

apiVersion.description: The API version the document was generated for: a tag of the API-Services repository, e.g. "2026-04". Not a language release tag.

sources.description: Which inputs were present when the document was generated. Without the specification there are no clause edges and no operation-to-endpoint mapping; without the OpenAPI knowledge there are no schemas.

types.description: Keyed by PIM type name, e.g. "Commit".

modelMapping.description: The rows of the specification's PIM-to-PSM model mapping table, as written. Empty without the specification.

pim.description: The type's PIM page, relative to the API version's knowledge folder.

members.description: Every effective PIM attribute of the type, owned and inherited. Present only for a class that has a PSM response schema to compare against.

psmOnly.description: Members of the PSM response schema that are not PIM attributes of the type.

method.description: clause-title: the clause is titled after the type. definition-paragraph: a paragraph of the clause opens by defining it. operation-signature: the clause lists the operation's signature. bold-mention: the name is set in bold in the clause, typically in a figure - the weakest.

responseMethod.description: mapping-table: stated by the specification's model mapping table. same-name: inferred from a shared name.

requestMethod.description: type-constant: stated by the OpenAPI document - a schema used in request bodies whose "@type" may only be the type's name.

inheritedFrom.description: The class the attribute is inherited from; absent when it is owned.

response.description: Whether the response schema has a member of the same name.

request.description: Whether the request schema has a member of the same name.

endpoints.description: The endpoints the specification maps the operation to on a single row of its endpoint mapping table.

mappingClause.description: The clause holding the endpoint mapping table, when the operation is named there. Set with no endpoints, the mapping spans several rows and has to be read in the clause.

operationId.description: The OpenAPI operation with that method and path; absent when the OpenAPI document has none.

pim.description: The PIM concept as written: a type, or "Type.member".
